story: Saturday afternoon in Sumter Oaks is breezy and clear at 84 degrees, and Gary is content to potter around his house while he waits for things to happen. Over at the Rec Center, Donna is determined to lock in a two-hour Tuesday pickleball slot for herself and Gary at the reservation kiosk. Out on Magnolia Loop, Hal grudgingly takes stock of the flamingo flock, counting only the birds visible from the street and squinting to see whether the hedge hides the rest. Rosa, equally determined, is making her way toward Gary's House.
events: Gary waited: puttering around Gary's House
Donna (court reservation kiosk): Reserve a two-hour Tuesday slot on a pickleball court for Gary and me
Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count only the flamingos visible from the street and note whether the hedge screens the rest

gary.thought_process: I've already pulled the cornmeal and started the batter, so the cornbread is well underway and the toolbox is sorted for approval day. It's mid-afternoon, nobody's around, and the cart is sitting right here. I can't touch the exterior mods until Architectural Review signs off (L-01), but I can bench-test the speakers and wiring at the workbench, which isn't visible from the street. That keeps me busy and useful while the cornbread gets ready for Rosa's dinner tonight. Staying put is better than wandering off with nothing to do.
gary.engine_note: tried to use None, which isn't in garys_house

donna.thought_process: I'm at the Rec Center with nobody around. I already confirmed the Tuesday two-hour slot with Gary in my calendar, but a slot in ink isn't a reservation until it's on the kiosk. L-05 caps me at 2 hours per party, so I'll book exactly two. Lock it in now, then check the ladder standings so I know who we're chasing.

parameters.content: Reserve a two-hour Tuesday slot on a pickleball court for Gary and me

hal.thought_process: Rosa just told me to put the clipboard down, and Donna's gone to the Rec Center, so there's nobody left to catch in the act. She's got a fair point. I've been counting birds when I could be keeping my word about Friday. The flamingo flock is right here on the street, though, and Donna's claim that the extras are behind the hedge is something I can check myself. Count only what's visible from the street, by the book, and let the facts decide. No sense hounding Rosa about it, she's already made her peace offering.

parameters.content: Count only the flamingos visible from the street and note whether the hedge screens the rest

rosa.thought_process: Hal is nearby counting flamingos again. I already told him at tick 393 to put the clipboard down and that I'd save him the head of the table, so repeating that would just be nagging. Donna already confirmed the extras are behind the hedge. Gary is still unconfirmed and I'm hosting Friday, so I should stop hovering and go do something about the dinner. Gary is the open question, so I'll head to his house to invite him in person and lock him in.

parameters.content: Heading over to Gary's to invite him to Friday's dinner in person so I get all three neighbors at my table.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
